notes.title: v1.5 Update
notes.notes: This update fixes missing some achievements not being registered on Steam. When you load a save slot, the game will now attempt to re-send unlocked achievements to Steam that previously failed to send.

notes.title: v1.4 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix bug where healing would get stuck if you removed the healing input on controller.
[*] Fix bug where game would be unresponsive if you paused the game right after dying.
[*] Add app icon.
[/list]

[i]This patch is the same as v1.3 but without the Steam achievements re-sending fix. v1.3 was causing a crash so I reverted it. I'm still trying to find a workaround to re-trigger previously failed Steam achievements.[/i]

notes.title: v1.3 Update
notes.notes:
This is the same patch as v1.2. I had to take v1.2 down because the app was crashing suddenly, but now that crash is fixed.

[list]
[*] Fix bug where healing would get stuck if you removed the healing input on controller.
[*] Fix bug where game would be unresponsive if you paused the game right after dying.
[*] If previous achievements failed to register, the game will now attempt to re-trigger them next time you load your save file.
[*] Add app icon.
[/list]

notes.title: Small bug fix update v1.2
notes.notes:
v1.2 fixes a few small bugs:
[list]
[*] Fix bug where healing would get stuck if you removed the healing input on controller.
[*] Fix bug where the game would become unresponsive if you paused the game right after dying.
[*] Fix bug where some Steam achievements failed to register despite the achievement being unlocked.
[*] Add app icon.
[/list]

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.notes:
Patch v1.1 fixes a few small bugs:
[list]
[*] Fix not being able to fast-fall when holding left or right.
[*] Fix “Show Tablet” not being accessible with a keyboard due to a key being double-bound.
[*] Fix player icon sometimes starting off screen in the overworld map.
[*] Fix overworld map sometimes having strange colors when pressing left/right after selecting a planet.
[/list]
